 Inside Derek Tran’s reelection campaign
 WESTMINSTER, Calif. — In 2024, Rep. Derek Tran’s (D-Calif.) 653-vote victory over former Rep. Michelle Steel (R-Calif.) wasn’t called until the day before Thanksgiving. Two years on, a lot has changed.
